Cam Hopton Reception Class 2027
We have open mornings for September 2027 intake.
If you were would like any further information, please do not hesitate to contact the school by telephone (01453 542763) or email (admin@camhopton.gloucs.sch.uk).
If you are thinking of joining our Cam Hopton family, you may like to watch our Reception Virtual Tour which will introduce you to our school, staff and pupils via the link below.
Reception Virtual Tour
Cam Hopton School Prospectus
Cam Hopton Admissions Policy
Autumn Term Clubs at Cam Hopton
Cam Hopton welcomes Read With Me volunteers
Working with community volunteers from Read With Me who offer one-to-one support in school, we aim to help every child learn to read well before they go to secondary school and take a full part in education.
Find out about Read with Me
Cam Hopton works in partnership with YOUNG MINDS MATTER.
Young Minds Matter is a safe, confidential mental health support service for school-aged children. They are part of the Gloucestershire NHS Child & Adolescent Mental Health Service (CAMHS) and a national scheme of Mental Health Support Teams (MHSTs).
To find out if this is something your child may find helpful follow the link below.

Cam Hopton's After School Clubs
At Cam Hopton, we are committed to providing our children with a wide variety of extra-curricular activities after school. We offer a range of clubs, most free of charge, to children of all ages across key stages 1 and 2 and view these opportunities as another way in which the school can build on the cultural capital of children. Activities include sports, music, art and book clubs. Children are able to explore who they are, what they enjoy and what they are good at whilst having lots of fun, making new friends and developing skills.
Clubs are run by a mixture of school staff and external coaches who we employ. They are very popular and are often oversubscribed. Each term, different children are invited to join the clubs that are running with the aim of providing all children at least one opportunity to participate in an after school club every year.
